reason: The parent preregistration names shared-purpose and format-readout collateral responses as descriptive secondary outputs. The initially hashed analyzer computed those endpoints internally but did not serialize their block-level values or summaries. This pre-outcome amendment serializes the already-declared descriptive outputs; it does not change any estimand, inferential test, threshold, multiplicity rule, decision criterion, or claim boundary.
